# Vulnerabilities in the resolved dependency graph that are known and accepted
# for a stated period.
#
# Three fields per entry, separated by " :: ":
#   package id :: expiry as YYYY-MM-DD :: the reason
#
# An acceptance is a decision with an end rather than a permanent hole. The
# register fails closed in both directions. An entry past its expiry is refused
# exactly like the vulnerability it covers, so living with something costs a
# second decision rather than nothing. An entry covering no vulnerability the
# current graph carries is refused as dangling, so it is removed by the change
# that raises the dependency instead of staying behind to cover a future
# advisory nobody read.
#
# What belongs in the reason is why the advisory does not reach this plugin, or
# what is being waited on and by when. "Not exploitable" on its own is a claim
# rather than a reason.
#
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
#
# There are no entries today. The graph carries no vulnerable package, which is
# the state this register exists to keep visible rather than a claim that it
# cannot change.
